name: org-standards
description: PeoplesHR organization standards for Claude Code. Ships the phx-sql-standards-review skill for reviewing T-SQL against the OLD hSenid HRM or NEW PeoplesHR PHR-X SQL standards, the phx-product-context skill for grounding answers about PeoplesHR module behaviour in the product documentation held in WeKnora, the phx-dbexplorer MCP server for browsing a database's schema, and the weknora MCP server for read-only retrieval from the PeoplesHR knowledge bases. The hrm-deployment-script, hrm-notification and phx-debugger skills moved to the dev-kit plugin in 3.0.0.
